dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, jagged high-contrast white perimeters forming 'O' and 'C' shapes across the dorsal midline; sharp pixel intensity transitions from charcoal-grey exteriors to bright white boundaries with darker interiors.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, solid white pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, concentrated primarily in the lower posterior-lateral region between larger annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent dorsal annuli form a roughly linear longitudinal arrangement along the spinal axis, with a slight lateral offset of the mid-body annulus towards the left pectoral flipper.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent reddish-pink focal lesion with irregular margins located on the posterior-ventral margin, showing a distinct loss of fur texture and high-contrast color deviation from the surrounding coat.
other_distinctive_markers: Five distinct, high-contrast dark claws visible on the pectoral flipper; a series of 3-4 parallel white transverse bands across the dorsal neck region.
